t: Forge Steel 4-iece circlip pliers set efficiently removes and installs circlips in various assembly and disassembly applications. Features an ergonomic, soft-grip PVC handle for comfortable use, and 4 interchangeable heat-treated carbon steel jaw attachments to provide exceptional flexibility. The strong, durable jaws provide a secure grip and stability, which is essential for automotive maintenance, engine work, and other engineering tasks. An auto-lock centre pin ensures the heads remain firmly in place during demanding jobs, improving safety and reliability.
